verdict.rationale: Riveter is an automation-capable enrichment platform with scheduled projects, reusable enrichments and run listing, so the versioning axis applies. The evidence never documents versioning, change review, or rollback of an enrichment or project configuration. Listing past runs (riveter-docs-22) and reusing an enrichment_id are adjacent run-history features, not versioning of the automation itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
